Operation: At each scan, identify valid active baskets and require all active members to have been seen. Keep candidates regardless of later label availability.
Read each token at its latest source timestamp at or before the scan; construct current features, consecutive-hour lags and changes.
Offline, label the following hour only when every active interval is decidable. Record occurrence and the maximum qualifying one-basket margin; preserve unknown targets.
At a weekly origin, fit preprocessing and models on known examples with label-end time strictly before the origin. Retune only at declared origins using earlier inner blocks.
Score every eligible event in the evaluation block at its hourly scan. Select up to N by descending score, resolving ties by event identifier.
Evaluate selected rows against their known labels. Separately replay selected monitoring windows under fixed arrival and unwind assumptions.
